summary: Clicked "Mark Ready" on RD-1015 and the app rejected it with the alert: 'Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd89-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier; Part "fwrd89-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier'. So the single enforced precondition is that every part carries a supplier (the form's own hint calls the Supplier field optional, but Ready does not accept blanks). I satisfied it by editing each part and setting Supplier = "Bench Supply Co"; the "Mark Ready" click then succeeded and the Part A/Part B rows now both show that supplier. Final status verified as Ready — the page's status paragraph reads "Status / Ready" and the "Mark Ready" button has been replaced by "Mark Draft" and "Mark Closed". Prices unchanged ($187.50 and $250.00).
